description_short: The European Master in Sustainable Systems Engineering (EMSSE), a two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, takes applications for its 2027-2029 intake through application.emsse.eu from 15 November 2026 to 15 February 2027 (23:59 Paris time); interviews run 18 to 20 March 2027.
